purpose: Independent external reference values from published NASA technical reports and peer-reviewed lunar science literature used to cross-validate the pad-scale slope, boulder hazard, regolith Terzaghi bearing, plume-surface interaction (PSI), and DSN X-band RF link budget models.

pad_scale_fractal_slope.citation: Rosenburg, M. A., Aharonson, O., Head, J. W., et al. (2011), 'Global surface slopes and roughness of the Moon from the Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter', Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets, 116, E02001, doi:10.1029/2010JE003716.

boulder_morphometry_and_diviner_ra.citation: Bandfield, J. L., Ghent, R. R., Vasavada, A. R., et al. (2011), 'Lunar surface rock abundance and regolith fines temperatures derived from LRO Diviner Radiometer data', JGR Planets, 116, E00H02; and Cintala, M. J., & McBride, K. M. (1995), NASA TM-4680 (Surveyor I, III, VI, VII & Apollo 16 boulder morphometry).

regolith_terzaghi_bearing_and_apollo_sin.citation: Carrier, W. D., Olhoeft, G. R., & Mendell, W. (1991), 'Physical Properties of the Lunar Surface', in Lunar Sourcebook: A User's Guide to the Moon, Cambridge Univ. Press, Ch. 9, Table 9.4 & Eqs. 9.12-9.15 (pp. 475-567); Apollo 11/15/16 Lunar Module footpad sinkage telemetry.

plume_surface_interaction_metzger2011.citation: Metzger, P. T., Smith, J., & Lane, J. E. (2011), 'Phenomenology of soil erosion due to rocket exhaust on the Moon and the Mauna Kea lunar test site', JGR Planets, 116, E06005; and Immer, C., et al. (2011), Apollo 12 / Surveyor III exhaust scouring analysis.

dsn_34m_bwg_xband_link.citation: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (2022), DSN Telecommunications Link Design Handbook (810-005, Rev. E, Module 104: 34-m BWG Stations).
